_README: Accumulated local ground truth for this project. Every entry OVERRIDES facts.json and any AI output, permanently (hard rule 8). Stage 3 MUST load this alongside facts.json before writing any batch. Append a record whenever the user corrects a fact, a recommendation, or a recurring style/voice mistake — future articles inherit the fix automatically.

corrections.wrong: AI panel members named specific websites as 'scam sites' (including at least one arguably legitimate info site)
corrections.right: Never name specific domains as scams. Warn generically about paid third-party 'ETIAS/visa application' sites and link ONLY the official EU ETIAS URL

corrections.wrong: Press claims of tourist tax 'up to €15/night' used as a citable figure
corrections.right: Tourist-tax numbers come exclusively from the official Catalan tax agency (IEET) table, refreshed at write time

corrections.wrong: Writing Camp Nou tour details from memory mid-renovation
corrections.right: camp-nou-tour-guide requires a mandatory live verification of tour/stadium status at write time; until then other articles mention Camp Nou only with 'check current tour status' framing

corrections.wrong: Assuming T-casual or standard metro tickets work for the airport metro
corrections.right: L9 Sud airport stations require a special Airport Ticket (~€5.50-5.90, serve_live); T-casual and standard singles are NOT valid at Aeroport T1/T2. Hola Barcelona passes DO include the airport metro

corrections.wrong: Second-gate model (gemini) returned a fully hallucinated review: invented article slugs and quoted sentences that do not exist in the batch (likely input truncation on the 83k-char paste)
corrections.right: Gate prompts must (a) be split so each paste stays well under free-tier input limits, (b) require the model to FIRST list the exact slugs it sees as a canary, and (c) require verbatim quotes. Every gate response is mechanically validated: quoted sentences must exist in the batch and slugs must match, else the review is rejected unread

corrections.wrong: Gemini (free tier) failed the slug canary on BOTH split gate pastes — twice hallucinating non-existent articles, even recycling facts.json dispute content as fake findings
corrections.right: Use DeepSeek as the default second-gate reader for this project. Any gate reply whose step-0 slug list does not exactly match the batch is rejected unread, regardless of model

corrections.wrong: In-body <figure> image URLs were written with the literal placeholder res.cloudinary.com/CLOUD/ because the cloud name was not yet known when figures were generated; broke all body-image previews in admin
corrections.right: Always substitute the real Cloudinary cloud name (from SITE_CONFIG.cloudinary.cloud / NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD) into figure URLs BEFORE building the import file. Never ship a CLOUD/<placeholder> URL. Better: store only the public_id and let the site build the URL at render time, matching how featured_image works

corrections.wrong: upload-batch.mjs defaulted CLOUDINARY_FOLDER to the literal previous site (vmarokko) and derived the preset name as <BASE>_articles (plural), while the actual preset was <site>_article (singular); images silently uploaded to vmarokko/articles/<site>/articles/<slug>
corrections.right: Per upload run, set CLOUDINARY_FOLDER=<thissite> explicitly. Template fix: upload-batch.mjs must REQUIRE CLOUDINARY_FOLDER (no vmarokko fallback — throw if unset) and the preset name must match what is actually created in Cloudinary. Standardize preset names to <site>_articles + <site>_media at site setup. Presets are SIGNED across this network (script signs); do not switch to unsigned

corrections.wrong: Gemini failed the slug canary again on batch 2 (both parts) — invented slugs from future/other batches (bcn-airport-to-city, barcelona-tourist-tax-explained, luxury-hotels-barcelona, camp-nou-tour-guide) and recycled corrections.json content as fake findings
corrections.right: Confirmed: Gemini free-tier is unusable as a gate reader for this project. Grok passed both batch-2 parts with correct canaries and clean reads — Grok and DeepSeek are the approved gate readers; Gemini is filler-only

corrections.wrong: Tourist-tax articles mentioned the press "€15" figure even to debunk it; gate readers split on whether corrections #2 allows surfacing the banned figure at all
corrections.right: Do not surface the "€15" press figure even to correct it. State only the current official IEET rate and, if useful, note rates are set by the Catalan tax authority and scheduled to keep rising — without citing the specific future-ceiling number. Verified official Barcelona rates effective 1 Apr 2026: 5-star €12.00, 4-star €8.40, tourist apartments €9.50, youth hostels €6.00; per person, ages 16+, first 7 nights

corrections.rule: Magic Fountain (Font Màgica, Montjuïc) shows have been subject to drought/water-restriction SUSPENSION. NEVER present showtimes or the show as definitely running. Always hedge: 'when/if running, check current status' + note seasonal schedule + water-restriction suspension. Applies to montjuic, rainy-day, best-views, with-kids, free-things, festivals — any article mentioning it.
